note: What a client that registers itself may ask for (AI-90; p1-mcp-first-party design D14), reviewed like code. A name that folds to Fyniq's own, or to a word of authority, is refused. A name that folds to a brand (Claude, Anthropic) is accepted only when every https redirect is on that brand's own hosts, so a real Claude connector can register and a look-alike cannot. A denied name or redirect host is refused. The registration is always agent class, public, PKCE, with the default scope alone; nothing here widens it.
